Class ClientRequest

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.shared.network.requests.ClientRequest
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
ClientConnection, ClientDisconnected, ClientPing, CreateGameRequest, EnterGameRequest, ExitGameRequest, ExitLobbyRequest, LoginRequest, LogoutRequest, MoveRequest, StartGameRequest, TotemPickingRequest
public abstract class ClientRequest extends Object implements Serializable
Abstract base for all requests sent from client to server over the network. Serialised to JSON via Jackson using the "type" discriminator field. The visitor pattern (accept(RequestVisitor, T)) dispatches each subtype to the correct handler in RequestVisitor without instanceof checks.

      public abstract <T> void accept(RequestVisitor<T> visitor, T context) throws ServerException
      Dispatches this request to the appropriate visit method on visitor, passing context as the second argument.
      Type Parameters:
      T - the context type (e.g. VirtualClient on the server)
      Parameters:
      visitor - the visitor to dispatch to
      context - the context object accompanying the request
      Throws:
      ServerException - if the visitor rejects the request
